---
title: "Core concepts"
---

## Object, assay, layer

A Seurat object is the container for expression matrices, metadata, reductions, graphs, images, commands, and provenance. The assay says what measurement family is active; a layer says which matrix representation is being used. A function can be syntactically valid and still be scientifically wrong if it reads the wrong assay or layer.

## QC is a decision, not a decorative plot

Quality control should expose library size, detected features, mitochondrial/ribosomal content, doublet evidence, and any study-specific exclusion rule. Save the thresholds and the number of retained observations.

## Reduction and neighbors are different questions

PCA or another linear reduction summarizes variation. A neighbor graph encodes local relationships. UMAP is a visualization of a chosen neighborhood structure, not a replacement for checking the graph or the input assumptions.

## Integration has a trade-off

Integration can reduce technical separation, but it can also erase biology if the design is poorly specified. Always compare an integrated view with an uncorrected view and record the grouping variable used for correction.

## Annotation is evidence assembly

A marker list is not a cell identity by itself. Annotation combines markers, negative markers, reference knowledge, sample context, and uncertainty. A tutorial should show the evidence used for each label.

## Downstream questions

| Question | Typical evidence | Boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Composition | proportions by sample or condition | cell counts are not independent biological replicates |
| Differential expression | model with design-aware replication | a cell-level p-value is not automatically a study-level result |
| Enrichment | ranked genes and a declared universe | pathway labels depend on database and background |
| Trajectory | graph or pseudotime under explicit assumptions | pseudotime is not a measured time course |
| Spatial organization | coordinates, neighborhood, and local signal | spatial association is not mechanism |

## Read the upstream reference

Use the [SCOP API Reference](https://mengxu98.github.io/scop/reference/) for the exact function signature and arguments. This site is a learning layer, not a second generated reference.
